title: [config] parseQuantity: characterization test for parseQuantity on decimals, zero, padding and exponents
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceAI-Workspace

add a characterization test for parseQuantity in src/config.ts: quantity parsing
- parseQuantity("2.5") is 1
- parseQuantity("0") is 1
- parseQuantity(" 3 ") is 3
- parseQuantity("1e2") is 100

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v1): Peace's task (source: peace). src/config.test.ts covers 7, -2 and abc; this pins decimals, zero, padded and exponent input (Number() semantics). Self-zone task on PeaceAI-Workspace: one new src/*.test.ts file only. No gate, grading, approval, leak, rule or workflow file is touched. A box dry-run on PeaceAI-Workspace c7ba0a5 (Workspace main, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v1); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with parseQuantity stubbed); with all five new tests of this batch: typecheck ok, npm test 17/17, test:self 5/5, test:tools 1077/1078 (only the box-only m48 snapshot test). Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
